import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot comparing Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep, colored by BMI Category
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, 
                               x='Sleep Duration', 
                               y='Quality of Sleep', 
                               hue='BMI Category', 
                               style='Gender', 
                               palette='deep',
                               s=100)

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=14)

# Customize legend
plt.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot to a file

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot comparing Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep, colored by BMI Category
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, 
                               x='Sleep Duration', 
                               y='Quality of Sleep', 
                               hue='BMI Category', 
                               style='Gender', 
                               palette='deep',
                               s=100)

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=14)

# Customize legend
plt.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
